name: opentherank-global-app-store-price-index
title: Global App Store Price Index (OpenTheRank)
description: The Global App Store Price Index measures how much the same app subscriptions cost in 18 countries compared with the United States. For each country it reports the median percentage difference between local prices and US prices for the same plans, converted to US dollars, together with its spread, a purchasing-power ratio based on IMF World Economic Outlook data, category medians, and the 3,120 individual prices behind every figure. Compiled by OpenTheRank (https://opentherank.com/open-data/app-price-index/) and published under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Apple App Store storefronts and vendor pricing pages, read by OpenTheRank
IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO April 2026), PPP conversion factors

fields.name: snapshot_date
fields.description: Day this snapshot was taken (UTC).

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the App Store storefront.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name in English.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Rank among the 18 countries, 1 = furthest below US prices.

fields.name: index_pct_vs_us
fields.description: The index: median percentage difference between this storefront's subscription prices and the US prices of the same plans, both converted to USD at the market rate. Negative = cheaper than the US.

fields.name: p10_pct
fields.description: 10th percentile of the same per-plan percentage differences.

fields.name: p25_pct
fields.description: 25th percentile.

fields.name: p75_pct
fields.description: 75th percentile.

fields.name: p90_pct
fields.description: 90th percentile.

fields.name: cheaper_share
fields.description: Share of the basket priced below the US (0 to 1).

fields.name: ppp_ratio
fields.description: Median of price_usd / (PPP price level x us_price_usd), with the price level from IMF PPP conversion factors over the market rate (US = 1). 1 = in line with the country's general price level; above 1 = dearer than that level would suggest.

fields.name: basket_n
fields.description: Subscriptions in the median: App Store and vendor-website plans with a US price, one plan per product.

fields.name: usd_billed
fields.description: True when this App Store storefront prices in US dollars, which pulls the index towards 0.

fields.name: prices_as_of
fields.description: Most recent day a price in the basket was checked.

fields.name: fx_date
fields.description: Day of the exchange rates used for the USD conversions.

fields.name: ppp_source
fields.description: Edition of the IMF World Economic Outlook the PPP factors come from.

fields.name: snapshot_date
fields.description: Day this snapshot was taken (UTC).

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the App Store storefront.

fields.name: category
fields.description: ai, streaming, photo-video, productivity, education, social or mobile-game. Only categories with at least 5 products in a country are listed.

fields.name: median_pct_vs_us
fields.description: Median percentage difference vs the US within the category. Mobile games are App Store games and are not part of the index itself.

fields.name: n
fields.description: Products in the category median.

fields.name: snapshot_date
fields.description: Day this snapshot was taken (UTC).

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the storefront.

fields.name: product_slug
fields.description: Stable product identifier on opentherank.com.

fields.name: product
fields.description: Product name.

fields.name: category
fields.description: ai, streaming, photo-video, productivity, education, social or mobile-game.

fields.name: source
fields.description: app_store: the App Store storefront of that country. vendor_website: the vendor's own pricing page for that country.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: The plan compared across countries: one representative plan per product; for mobile games, the in-app item or game purchase compared.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Billing period: week, month or year for subscriptions; one-time for most mobile-game rows (an in-app item or a paid game).

fields.name: price_local
fields.description: The price exactly as the storefront printed it, in local currency.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of price_local.

fields.name: price_usd
fields.description: price_local converted to USD at the snapshot's exchange rates (fx_date in the country index and the JSON file).

fields.name: us_price_usd
fields.description: The same plan's US price in USD.

fields.name: pct_vs_us
fields.description: Percentage difference: (price_usd / us_price_usd - 1) x 100.

fields.name: in_index
fields.description: True for the subscriptions in index_pct_vs_us; false for App Store games, which only feed the mobile-game category median.

fields.name: price_note
fields.description: Set when the storefront lists several purchase entries matching the plan: which entry is published and why, in the words of the product page. Empty otherwise.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Day the product's prices were last read from the store or vendor.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The opentherank.com page this price is published on.

fields.name: product
fields.description: Product name.

fields.name: category
fields.description: ai, streaming, photo-video, productivity, education, social or mobile-game.

fields.name: source
fields.description: app_store: the App Store storefront of that country. vendor_website: the vendor's own pricing page for that country.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: The plan compared across countries: one representative plan per product; for mobile games, the in-app item or game purchase compared.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Billing period: week, month or year for subscriptions; one-time for most mobile-game rows (an in-app item or a paid game).

fields.name: price_local
fields.description: The price exactly as the storefront printed it, in local currency.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of price_local.

fields.name: price_usd
fields.description: price_local converted to USD at the snapshot's exchange rates (fx_date in the country index and the JSON file).

fields.name: us_price_usd
fields.description: The same plan's US price in USD.

fields.name: pct_vs_us
fields.description: Percentage difference: (price_usd / us_price_usd - 1) x 100.

fields.name: in_index
fields.description: True for the subscriptions in index_pct_vs_us; false for App Store games, which only feed the mobile-game category median.

fields.name: price_note
fields.description: Set when the storefront lists several purchase entries matching the plan: which entry is published and why, in the words of the product page. Empty otherwise.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Day the product's prices were last read from the store or vendor.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The opentherank.com page this price is published on.

fields.name: snapshot_date
fields.description: Day this snapshot was taken (UTC).

fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the storefront.
